latestVersion.changelog:
Trimmer Software 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly trims and exports clean 1080p video clips from raw footage using plain text instructions.
- No timeline editing or complex export settings needed—simply upload, describe edits, and download the result in 20–40 seconds.
- Supports a wide range of video, audio, and image files (up to 500MB).
- Automatic session management: uses your NEMO_TOKEN or fetches a free trial token if needed, then connects to the backend for smooth operations.
- Clear, user-friendly status updates and robust error handling throughout the workflow.
